description: This file is a shell script that performs self-healing network connectivity tests, including ping and DNS resolution checks, and may trigger a router reboot if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates and waits for a random amount of time before starting the ping tests.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Decides whether to reset the router based on process name.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test and triggers corrective action if the test fails and the configuration allows.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping tests to the default gateway and triggers corrective actions if pings fail.
